children: Bitcoin extended its losses, breaking below the $57,000 level.

As of 12:47 p.m. on November 21, Bitcoin was trading at $56,942.67 on Binance's USDT market, down 8.44% from a day earlier. It was the first time Bitcoin had fallen below $57,000 since September 2024, about two years and two months ago.

The decline also continued on South Korean exchanges. At the same time, Bitcoin traded at 78.5 million won on Upbit's won market, down 3.29% from the previous day and slipping below the 80 million won level.
Major altcoins, including Ethereum, also tumbled. Ethereum fell 9.95% to $1,576.79. XRP dropped 8.3% to $0.8848, while Solana slid 9.02% to $66.61.

The sharp price decline triggered large-scale forced liquidations in the digital-asset derivatives market. Futures positions worth about $416 million were liquidated over the past hour across major exchanges including Binance. Over the past 24 hours, total forced liquidations reached about $2.165 billion.

title: Bitcoin Breaks Below $57,000; $416 Million in Futures Liquidated in an Hour
